Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.code

Class CompiledFunction

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.code.CompiledFunction
public final class CompiledFunction extends Object
One compiled function: the instruction array, the constant pool, and the shape of the frame it needs.

Everything the machine must know before it runs a body is settled at compile time — how many slots, which of them are boxed cells, how many captures the closure takes, what the minimum argument count is once defaults are counted. The interpreter loop therefore contains no analysis, only fetch/decode/execute.

CompiledFunction.Builder is the compiler's scratch space; a built function is immutable and shared, since one CompiledFunction backs every closure made from the same fun declaration.
